The '''''Suprosa'' supercomputer''' was a computer programmed into the systems of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] freighter ''[[Suprosa]]'' which contained technical data for the [[Death Star II/Legends|''Death Star II'']]. It was secured by [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and a group of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] during the [[Raid on the Suprosa|Raid on the ''Suprosa'']]. It was guarded last defense by a [[Loader droid/Legends|loader droid]] reprogrammed to kill the intruders.

==Behind the scenes==
In its appearance in the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]], it is designed to have the appearance of a [[Wikipedia:Nintendo 64|Nintendo 64]] from a distance.
